verses.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.en: The Lord’s message came to me:

verses.zh: 「你们在以色列地怎么用这俗语说『父亲吃了酸葡萄，儿子的牙酸倒了』呢？」
verses.en: “What do you mean by quoting this proverb concerning the land of Israel: “‘The fathers eat sour grapes,And the children’s teeth become numb?’[NOTE:1]
notes: This word occurs three times, in the Qal stem here and the parallel passage in Jer 31:29-30, and in the Piel stem at Eccl 10:10. In the latter passage it refers to the bluntness of an ax that has not been sharpened. Here the “bluntness” of the teeth is not due to grinding them down because of the bitter taste of sour grapes but to the fact that they have lost their “edge,” “bite,” or “sharpness” because they are numb from the sour taste. For this meaning for the word, see W. L. Holladay, Jeremiah (Hermeneia), 2:197.

verses.zh: 主耶和华说：「我指着我的永生起誓，你们在以色列中，必不再有用这俗语的因由。
verses.en: “As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord,[NOTE:1] you will not quote this proverb in Israel anymore!

verses.zh: 看哪，世人都是属我的；为父的怎样属我，为子的也照样属我；犯罪的，他必死亡。
verses.en: Indeed! All lives are mine—the life of the father as well as the life of the son is mine. The one[NOTE:1] who sins will die.
notes: Heb “life.”

verses.zh: 「人若是公义，且行正直与合理的事：
verses.en: “Suppose a man is righteous. He practices what is just and right;

verses.zh: 未曾在山上吃过祭偶像之物，未曾仰望以色列家的偶像，未曾玷污邻舍的妻，未曾在妇人的经期内亲近她，
verses.en: does not eat pagan sacrifices on the mountains[NOTE:1] or pray to the idols[NOTE:2] of the house of Israel; does not defile his neighbor’s wife; does not approach a woman for marital relations[NOTE:3] during her period;
notes: Heb “on the mountains he does not eat.” The mountains are often mentioned as the place where idolatrous sacrifices were eaten (Ezek 20:28; 22:9; 34:6).
Heb “does not lift up his eyes.” This refers to looking to idols for help.
The expression קָרַב אֶל (qarav ʾel) means “draw near to” or “approach,” but is also used as a euphemism for the intended purpose of sexual relations (Lev 18:14; Deut 22:14; Isa 8:3).

verses.zh: 未曾亏负人，乃将欠债之人的当头还给他；未曾抢夺人的物件，却将食物给饥饿的人吃，将衣服给赤身的人穿；
verses.en: does not oppress anyone, but gives the debtor back whatever was given in pledge;[NOTE:1] does not commit robbery,[NOTE:2] but gives his bread to the hungry and clothes the naked;
notes: Heb “restores to the debtor his pledge.” The root occurs in Exod 22:25 in reference to restoring a man’s garment as a pledge before nightfall.
The Hebrew term refers to seizure of property, usually by the rich (Isa 3:14; 10:2; Mic 2:2; see Lev 5:21, 22 HT [6:2, 3 ET]).

verses.zh: 未曾向借钱的弟兄取利，也未曾向借粮的弟兄多要，缩手不作罪孽，在两人之间，按至理判断；
verses.en: does not engage in usury or charge interest,[NOTE:1] but refrains[NOTE:2] from wrongdoing; promotes true justice[NOTE:3] between men;
notes: This law was given in Lev 25:36.
Heb, “turns back his hand.”
Heb “justice of truth.”

verses.zh: 遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，按诚实行事―这人是公义的，必定存活。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.en: and follows my statutes and observes my regulations by carrying them out.[NOTE:1] That man[NOTE:2] is righteous; he will certainly live,[NOTE:3] declares the Sovereign Lord.
notes: The MT reads לַעֲשׂוֹת אֱמֶת (laʿasot ʾemet, “to do with integrity”), while the LXX reads “to do them,” presupposing לַעֲשׂוֹת אֹתָם (laʿasot ʾotam). The ם (mem) and ת (tav) have been reversed in the MT. The LXX reflects the original, supported by similar phrasing in Ezekiel 11:20; 20:19.
Heb “he.”
Heb “living, he will live.” The infinitive absolute precedes the finite verb for emphasis.

verses.zh: 「他若生一个儿子，作强盗，是流人血的，不行以上所说之善，反行其中之恶，乃在山上吃过祭偶像之物，并玷污邻舍的妻，
verses.en: “Suppose such a man has[NOTE:1] a violent son who sheds blood and does any of these things[NOTE:2] mentioned previously
notes: Heb “begets.”

Heb “and he does, a brother, from one of these.” If “brother” is retained, it may be an adverbial accusative: “against a brother” (i.e., fellow Israelite). But the form is likely dittographic, as the consonants that spell “brother” אח (alef-het) occur in the following word).

verses.zh: a
verses.en: (though the father did not do any of them).[NOTE:1] He eats pagan sacrifices on the mountains,[NOTE:2] defiles his neighbor’s wife,
notes: Heb “and he all of these did not do.” The parenthetical note refers back to the father described in the preceding verses.
See note on “mountains” in v. 6.

verses.zh: 亏负困苦和穷乏的人，抢夺人的物，未曾将当头还给人，仰望偶像，并行可憎的事，
verses.en: oppresses the poor and the needy,[NOTE:1] commits robbery, does not give back what was given in pledge, prays to[NOTE:2] idols, performs abominable acts,
notes: The poor and needy are often mentioned together in the OT (Deut 24:14; Jer 22:16; Ezek 16:49; Pss 12:6; 35:10; 37:14).
Heb “lifts up his eyes.”

verses.zh: 向借钱的弟兄取利，向借粮的弟兄多要―这人岂能存活呢？他必不能存活。他行这一切可憎的事，必要死亡，他的罪（原文是血）必归到他身上。
verses.en: engages in usury, and charges interest. Will he live? He will not! Because he has done all these abominable deeds he will certainly die.[NOTE:1] He will bear the responsibility for his own death.[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “be put to death.” The translation follows an alternative reading that appears in several ancient textual witnesses.
Heb “his blood will be upon him.”

verses.zh: 「他若生一个儿子，见父亲所犯的一切罪便惧怕（有古卷：思量），不照样去做；
verses.en: “But suppose he in turn has a son who notices all the sins his father commits, considers them, and does not follow his father’s example.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and he sees and does not do likewise.”

verses.zh: 未曾在山上吃过祭偶像之物，未曾仰望以色列家的偶像，未曾玷污邻舍的妻，
verses.en: He does not eat pagan sacrifices on the mountains, does not pray to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor’s wife,

verses.zh: 未曾亏负人，未曾取人的当头，未曾抢夺人的物件，却将食物给饥饿的人吃，将衣服给赤身的人穿，
verses.en: does not oppress anyone or keep what has been given in pledge, does not commit robbery, gives his food to the hungry and clothes the naked,

verses.zh: 缩手不害贫穷人，未曾向借钱的弟兄取利，也未曾向借粮的弟兄多要；他顺从我的典章，遵行我的律例，就不因父亲的罪孽死亡，定要存活。
verses.en: refrains from wrongdoing,[NOTE:1] does not engage in usury or charge interest, carries out my regulations, and follows my statutes. He will not die for his father’s iniquity;[NOTE:2] he will surely live.
notes: This translation follows the LXX. The MT reads: “restrains his hand from the poor,” which makes no sense here.

Or “in his father’s punishment.” The phrase “in/for [a person’s] iniquity/punishment” occurs fourteen times in Ezekiel: here and in vv. 18, 19, 20; 3:18, 19; 4:17; 7:13, 16; 24:23; 33:6, 8, 9; 39:23. The Hebrew word for “iniquity” may also mean the “punishment for iniquity.”

verses.zh: 至于他父亲；因为欺人太甚，抢夺弟兄，在本国的民中行不善，他必因自己的罪孽死亡。
verses.en: As for his father, because he practices extortion, robs his brother, and does what is not good among his people, he will die for his iniquity.

verses.zh: 「你们还说：『儿子为何不担当父亲的罪孽呢？』儿子行正直与合理的事，谨守遵行我的一切律例，他必定存活。
verses.en: “Yet you say, ‘Why should the son not suffer[NOTE:1] for his father’s iniquity?’ When the son does what is just and right, and observes all my statutes and carries them out, he will surely live.
notes: Heb “lift up, bear.”

verses.zh: 惟有犯罪的，他必死亡。儿子必不担当父亲的罪孽，父亲也不担当儿子的罪孽。义人的善果必归自己，恶人的恶报也必归自己。
verses.en: The person who sins is the one who will die. A son will not suffer[NOTE:1] for his father’s iniquity, and a father will not suffer[NOTE:2] for his son’s iniquity; the righteous person will be judged according to his righteousness and the wicked person according to his wickedness.[NOTE:3]
notes: Heb “lift up, bear.”
Heb “lift up, bear.”
Heb “the righteousness of the righteous one will be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked one will be upon him.”

verses.zh: 「恶人若回头离开所做的一切罪恶，谨守我一切的律例，行正直与合理的事，他必定存活，不致死亡。
verses.en: “But if the wicked person turns from all the sin he has committed and observes all my statutes and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.

verses.zh: 他所犯的一切罪过都不被记念，因所行的义，他必存活。
verses.en: None of the sins he has committed will be held[NOTE:1] against him; because of the righteousness he has done, he will live.
notes: Heb “remembered.”

verses.zh: 主耶和华说：恶人死亡，岂是我喜悦的吗？不是喜悦他回头离开所行的道存活吗？
verses.en: Do I actually delight in the death of the wicked, declares the Sovereign Lord? Do I not prefer that he turn from his wicked conduct and live?

verses.zh: 义人若转离义行而作罪孽，照着恶人所行一切可憎的事而行，他岂能存活吗？他所行的一切义都不被记念；他必因所犯的罪、所行的恶死亡。
verses.en: “But if a righteous man turns away from his righteousness and practices wrongdoing according to all the abominable practices the wicked carry out, will he live? All his righteous acts will not be remembered; because of the unfaithful acts he has done and the sin he has committed, he will die.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “because of them he will die.”

verses.zh: 「你们还说：『主的道不公平！』以色列家啊，你们当听，我的道岂不公平吗？你们的道岂不是不公平吗？
verses.en: “Yet you say, ‘The Lord’s conduct[NOTE:1] is unjust!’ Hear, O house of Israel: Is my conduct unjust? Is it not your conduct that is unjust?
notes: Heb “way.”

verses.zh: 义人若转离义行而作罪孽死亡，他是因所作的罪孽死亡。
verses.en: When a righteous person turns back from his righteousness and practices wrongdoing, he will die for it;[NOTE:1] because of the wrongdoing he has done, he will die.
notes: Heb “for them” or “because of them.”

verses.zh: 再者，恶人若回头离开所行的恶，行正直与合理的事，他必将性命救活了。
verses.en: When a wicked person turns from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right, he will preserve his life.

verses.zh: 因为他思量，回头离开所犯的一切罪过，必定存活，不致死亡。
verses.en: Because he considered[NOTE:1] and turned from all the sins he had done, he will surely live; he will not die.
notes: Heb “he saw.”

verses.zh: 以色列家还说：『主的道不公平！』以色列家啊，我的道岂不公平吗？你们的道岂不是不公平吗？」
verses.en: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The Lord’s conduct is unjust!’ Is my conduct unjust, O house of Israel? Is it not your conduct that is unjust?

verses.zh: 所以主耶和华说：「以色列家啊，我必按你们各人所行的审判你们。你们当回头离开所犯的一切罪过。这样，罪孽必不使你们败亡。
verses.en: “Therefore, I will judge each person according to his conduct,[NOTE:1] O house of Israel, declares the Sovereign Lord. Repent[NOTE:2] and turn from all your wickedness; then it will not be an obstacle leading to iniquity.[NOTE:3]
notes: Heb “ways.”
The verbs and persons in this verse are plural whereas the individual has been the subject of the chapter.
Or “leading to punishment.”

verses.zh: 你们要将所犯的一切罪过尽行抛弃，自做一个新心和新灵。以色列家啊，你们何必死亡呢？
verses.en: Throw away all your sins you have committed and fashion yourselves a new heart and a new spirit![NOTE:1] Why should you die, O house of Israel?
notes: In Ezek 11:19 and 36:26 the new heart and new spirit are promised as future blessings.

verses.zh: 主耶和华说：我不喜悦那死人之死，所以你们当回头而存活。」
verses.en: For I take no delight in the death of anyone,[NOTE:1] declares the Sovereign Lord. Repent and live!
notes: Heb “the death of the one dying.”
